thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 🚨 — Elevated crashloop restarts for service `inference-api` in us-east-1 (canary rollout in progress). Pager duty: PD-3892. Please acknowledge.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.03.15-rc4 started canary (10% traffic) at 2026-03-15T01:00Z. Rolling pods: inference-api:v2026.03.15-rc4

Samir (SRE): Acked. I'm looking at logs and HPA metrics.

Samir (SRE): kubectl logs -n prod deployment/inference-api -c runtime | tail -n 50

QA-bot: Observed repeated OOMKilled and liveness probe failures for new replica set. Sample:
```
2026-03-15T01:02:12Z ERROR runtime: runtime/asm_amd64.s: OOMKilled
Liveness probe failed: HTTPProbe returned 500
```

Priya (platform): HPA metrics show scale-to-zero attempts when nodes were drained for maintenance. HPA config looks weird — minReplicas: 0 in the canary HPA yaml.

Samir (SRE): Confirmed. HPA inference-api-hpa (target CPU 60%) had minReplicas: 0 due to a templating bug in the chart. During node drain the canary pod count dropped to 0 briefly and new pods hit cold-start OOMs.

Marco (traffic): Canary at 10% => customer-facing 10% of traffic impacted. SLA alerts fired: 5xx rate jumped from ~0.3% to 6.5% in us-east-1.

Jin (oncall): I'm paged. Taking ownership. @Samir can you add the quick mitigations you want me to run?

Samir (SRE): Actions:
1) Kill the faulty RS (to stop flapping): `kubectl scale rs inference-api-v2026-rc4 --replicas=0 -n prod`
2) Revert the canary traffic percentage to 0 with deploy-bot (abort rollout)
3) Patch HPA to set minReplicas: 2 and roll it out

Samir (SRE): Quick commands:
```
kubectl -n prod patch hpa inference-api --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":2}]'
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference-api --timeout=5m
```

deploy-bot: Received abort request for rollout 2026.03.15-rc4. Initiating rollback to v2026.02.28.

Priya (platform): I'll apply the HPA patch as emergency config. Patching now.

Priya (platform): (patch applied) HPA minReplicas is 2. Observing pod spin-up.

Samir (SRE): After patch, pods start but some show elevated memory usage — looks like rc4 increases memory peak during init. We should avoid reintroducing rc4 until we fix memory inflation.

Jin (oncall): Rollback confirmed by deploy-bot. Traffic reverting to v2026.02.28. Canary flagged off. Monitoring.

Marco (traffic): US-east 5xx rate dropping to 1.1% and trending down. Good.

Samir (SRE): For immediate mitigation we also enabled temporary circuit-breaker in the ingress to reduce concurrent requests to inference-api (limit 50 rps) to avoid OOM spikes.

Jin (oncall): Customer impact assessment — snippet for incident timeline:
- 01:00Z deploy 2026.03.15-rc4 canary started (10% traffic)
- 01:02Z increased 5xx and OOMKilled observed
- 01:04Z PD page fired and oncall acknowledged
- 01:06Z HPA discovered misconfigured minReplicas:0
- 01:09Z HPA patched to minReplicas:2
- 01:12Z deploy-bot rollback to v2026.02.28 initiated
- 01:18Z traffic reverted; 5xx substantially reduced

Jin (oncall): Impact: approx 10% of traffic to inference API in us-east-1 experienced elevated 5xx (~6% error rate) for ~12 minutes. No data exposure. Potentially affected customers: internal telemetry suggests a spike of ~84k requests failed.

Priya (platform): Root cause notes: templating bug in helm chart for canary HPA set minReplicas to helm default (0) instead of inheriting stable manifest. Secondary cause: rc4 memory regression.

Samir (SRE): Immediate postmortem action items (to-do):
- fix helm templates + add CI linting for HPA minReplicas (owner: Priya)
- add canary resource sanity check to rollout pipeline (owner: Samir)
- add memory regression guard in CI e2e (owner: QA)
- follow-up with engineering team that shipped rc4 for memory profile fix (owner: Marco)

Marco (traffic): Noting customer comms: small handful of SLAs hit; recommend status page post with ETA for root cause review. I'll coordinate with comms.

Jin (oncall): Handoff: I'll remain on until metrics are stable for 1h. If anything else spikes, page me. Adding this thread to incidents channel.

incident-bot: Incident PD-3892 resolved by rollback. Please open postmortem RFC within 48h and link here.

Samir (SRE): Adding logs and HPA diff to ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:

QA-bot: Automated regression test added to canary gating: memory usage check and HPA sanity rule.

Priya (platform): Filing PR for helm template fix now.

Jin (oncall): Closing this thread for active mitigation. Will keep it in incidents for the postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
